schema:
CREATE TABLE aisles (aisle TEXT PRIMARY KEY, floor INTEGER, zone TEXT)
CREATE TABLE kinds (kind TEXT PRIMARY KEY, description TEXT, aisle TEXT REFERENCES aisles(aisle))
CREATE TABLE maker_finishes (maker TEXT, kind TEXT, finish TEXT)
CREATE TABLE maker_kinds (maker TEXT, kind TEXT)
CREATE TABLE makers (maker TEXT PRIMARY KEY, country TEXT, founded INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE order_lines (order_id INTEGER, part_no TEXT, qty INTEGER, line_cost REAL)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, vendor TEXT, ordered TEXT, received TEXT, status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE stock_import ("Part No" TEXT, "Item Name" TEXT, "Kind" TEXT, "Maker" TEXT, "Unit Price / Rate" REAL, "Unit Cost" REAL, "Qty On Hand" INTEGER, "Reorder?" TEXT, "Last Counted" TEXT)
CREATE TABLE vendor_makers (vendor TEXT, maker TEXT)
CREATE TABLE vendors (vendor TEXT PRIMARY KEY, city TEXT, terms TEXT)

questions.question: How many parts are in stock_import?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_import

questions.question: How many vendors are in Tucson?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendors WHERE city = 'Tucson'

questions.question: How many kinds are shelved in aisle B2?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kinds WHERE aisle = 'B2'

questions.question: List the Part No of every part with a selling price over 20.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No" FROM stock_import WHERE "Unit Price / Rate" > 20

questions.question: List the Item Name of every screw part with fewer than 20 on hand.
questions.gold: SELECT "Item Name" FROM stock_import WHERE "Kind" = 'screw' AND "Qty On Hand" < 20

questions.question: List the Part No of parts flagged for reorder.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No" FROM stock_import WHERE "Reorder?" = 'Y'

questions.question: List the Part No and Item Name of every part made by Hesketh.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No", "Item Name" FROM stock_import WHERE "Maker" = 'Hesketh'

questions.question: How many parts have nothing on hand?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_import WHERE "Qty On Hand" = 0

questions.question: List the Item Name of parts whose name contains 'Brass'.
questions.gold: SELECT "Item Name" FROM stock_import WHERE "Item Name" LIKE '%Brass%'

questions.question: List the Part No of parts that sell for more than they cost.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No" FROM stock_import WHERE "Unit Price / Rate" > "Unit Cost"

questions.question: How many parts have no cost recorded?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_import WHERE "Unit Cost" IS NULL

questions.question: How many parts have never been flagged either way in the reorder column?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_import WHERE "Reorder?" IS NULL

questions.question: What is the average unit cost across parts that have a cost recorded?
questions.gold: SELECT AVG("Unit Cost") FROM stock_import

questions.question: How many orders have not been received yet?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE received IS NULL

questions.question: How many parts are not flagged Y for reorder, counting parts with no flag at all?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_import WHERE "Reorder?" IS NULL OR "Reorder?" <> 'Y'

questions.question: What is the total quantity on hand across all parts?
questions.gold: SELECT SUM("Qty On Hand") FROM stock_import

questions.question: What is the average selling price of screw parts?
questions.gold: SELECT AVG("Unit Price / Rate") FROM stock_import WHERE "Kind" = 'screw'

questions.question: What is the lowest selling price in stock_import?
questions.gold: SELECT MIN("Unit Price / Rate") FROM stock_import

questions.question: What is the total value on hand at selling price (price times quantity)?
questions.gold: SELECT SUM("Unit Price / Rate" * "Qty On Hand") FROM stock_import

questions.question: What is the total line cost of order 5007?
questions.gold: SELECT SUM(line_cost) FROM order_lines WHERE order_id = 5007

questions.question: How many parts are there of each kind? Return kind and count.
questions.gold: SELECT "Kind", COUNT(*) FROM stock_import GROUP BY "Kind"

questions.question: What is the average selling price per kind? Return kind and average.
questions.gold: SELECT "Kind", AVG("Unit Price / Rate") FROM stock_import GROUP BY "Kind"

questions.question: What is the total quantity on hand per maker? Return maker and total.
questions.gold: SELECT "Maker", SUM("Qty On Hand") FROM stock_import GROUP BY "Maker"

questions.question: How many orders has each vendor placed? Return vendor and count.
questions.gold: SELECT vendor, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY vendor

questions.question: Which kinds have more than 12 parts? Return the kind.
questions.gold: SELECT "Kind" FROM stock_import GROUP BY "Kind" HAVING COUNT(*) > 12

questions.question: Which vendors have placed at least 5 orders? Return the vendor.
questions.gold: SELECT vendor FROM orders GROUP BY vendor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

questions.question: List the vendors that supply the maker Dralund.
questions.gold: SELECT vendor FROM vendor_makers WHERE maker = 'Dralund'

questions.question: List the distinct cities of vendors that supply Dralund.
questions.gold: SELECT DISTINCT v.city FROM vendors v JOIN vendor_makers vm ON vm.vendor = v.vendor WHERE vm.maker = 'Dralund'

questions.question: On which floor is the hinge kind shelved?
questions.gold: SELECT a.floor FROM kinds k JOIN aisles a ON a.aisle = k.aisle WHERE k.kind = 'hinge'

questions.question: List the kinds shelved on floor 2.
questions.gold: SELECT k.kind FROM kinds k JOIN aisles a ON a.aisle = k.aisle WHERE a.floor = 2

questions.question: List the Part No of parts whose kind is shelved in the Doors zone.
questions.gold: SELECT s."Part No" FROM stock_import s JOIN kinds k ON k.kind = s."Kind" JOIN aisles a ON a.aisle = k.aisle WHERE a.zone = 'Doors'

questions.question: List the countries of the makers that Delmar Brothers buys from (distinct).
questions.gold: SELECT DISTINCT m.country FROM vendor_makers vm JOIN makers m ON m.maker = vm.maker WHERE vm.vendor = 'Delmar Brothers'

questions.question: Which kinds does Brandel supply? Return the kind.
questions.gold: SELECT kind FROM maker_kinds WHERE maker = 'Brandel'

questions.question: Which makers supply the screw kind? Return the maker.
questions.gold: SELECT maker FROM maker_kinds WHERE kind = 'screw'

questions.question: Which finishes does Dralund offer for washer? Return the finish.
questions.gold: SELECT finish FROM maker_finishes WHERE maker = 'Dralund' AND kind = 'washer'

questions.question: Which makers offer a nickel finish for washer? Return the maker.
questions.gold: SELECT maker FROM maker_finishes WHERE kind = 'washer' AND finish = 'nickel'

questions.question: List the Part No of the most expensive part or parts by selling price.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No" FROM stock_import WHERE "Unit Price / Rate" = (SELECT MAX("Unit Price / Rate") FROM stock_import)

questions.question: List the Part No of the cheapest part or parts by selling price.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No" FROM stock_import WHERE "Unit Price / Rate" = (SELECT MIN("Unit Price / Rate") FROM stock_import)

questions.question: Which kind or kinds have the most parts? Return the kind.
questions.gold: SELECT "Kind" FROM stock_import GROUP BY "Kind" HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM stock_import GROUP BY "Kind"))

questions.question: List the Part No of parts that sell for more than the average selling price.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No" FROM stock_import WHERE "Unit Price / Rate" > (SELECT AVG("Unit Price / Rate") FROM stock_import)

questions.question: Which makers have no parts in stock_import? Return the maker.
questions.gold: SELECT maker FROM makers WHERE maker NOT IN (SELECT "Maker" FROM stock_import)

questions.question: Which vendors have never placed an order? Return the vendor.
questions.gold: SELECT vendor FROM vendors WHERE vendor NOT IN (SELECT vendor FROM orders)

questions.question: List the Part No of parts that have never been ordered.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No" FROM stock_import WHERE "Part No" NOT IN (SELECT part_no FROM order_lines)

questions.question: List the Part No of parts last counted in March 2026.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No" FROM stock_import WHERE "Last Counted" LIKE '03/%/2026'

questions.question: List the order_id of orders placed in the third quarter of 2026 (July to September).
questions.gold: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE ordered >= '2026-07-01' AND ordered < '2026-10-01'

questions.question: List the order_id of received orders that took more than 10 days from order to receipt.
questions.gold: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE received IS NOT NULL AND julianday(received) - julianday(ordered) > 10

questions.question: What is the most recent order date for each vendor? Return vendor and date.
questions.gold: SELECT vendor, MAX(ordered) FROM orders GROUP BY vendor

questions.question: List the Part No and selling price of the 5 most expensive parts, highest first, ties broken by Part No ascending.
questions.gold: SELECT "Part No", "Unit Price / Rate" FROM stock_import ORDER BY "Unit Price / Rate" DESC, "Part No" ASC LIMIT 5

questions.question: List the order_id and ordered date of the 3 most recent orders, newest first, ties broken by order_id descending.
questions.gold: SELECT order_id, ordered FROM orders ORDER BY ordered DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: List every maker with its founding year, oldest first.
questions.gold: SELECT maker, founded FROM makers ORDER BY founded ASC
